opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable collaborative projects between the UK and Japan across a wide range of fields, encouraging mutual understanding, exchange of ideas, and lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Small Grants – Japan office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable collaborative projects between the UK and Japan across a wide range of fields, encouraging mutual understanding, exchange of ideas, and lasting collaboration.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; preference for early‑career practitioners, managers or carers in health‑related fields; must involve partners in both the UK and Japan; projects must centre on medicine and health.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
